recommendations.description: Fix path traversal vulnerability in report filename generation (main.ts:102). User input owner/repo are used directly in filenames without sanitization, allowing potential directory escape attacks.
Remove debug console.log statement left in production code (main.ts:86) and fix async in Promise constructor (rate-limiter.ts:261) which violates best practices and can cause unhandled rejections.

Implement comprehensive test suite with 50-60+ test cases covering orchestrator, main entry point, rate limiter, error handler, and report generator. Current coverage is 3-5% with only empty test stubs.

Extract environment validation logic (CLI args, authentication) from main.ts into reusable utility functions to eliminate duplication between main.ts and orchestrator.ts. Create src/utils/validation.ts with validateCLIArguments() and validateAuthentication().
Implement proper error boundaries and error handling in orchestrator message processing loop (orchestrator.ts:58-96). Add try-catch wrapping and type guards for safer message discrimination.
Fix potential race condition in RateLimiter with concurrent access to activeRequests and requestHistory (rate-limiter.ts:73-77). Implement mutex/locking mechanism for thread-safe state management.
Address unbounded array growth in rate-limiter requestHistory (rate-limiter.ts:38). Implement maximum array size limit or more aggressive pruning to prevent memory leaks.
Reduce DRY violations in report-generator by extracting list formatting logic into formatListWithTruncation() helper method. Currently duplicated for issues, test gaps, and refactoring suggestions.
Move hardcoded emoji characters from report-generator.ts to configuration file or use text alternatives. Emojis can cause encoding issues and reduce accessibility.
Modernize withRateLimit function to use async/await with finally block instead of Promise constructor with async callback (rate-limiter.ts:256-272). This is an anti-pattern that should be replaced.
